title: Data Driven Experience
description: An interactive racing activation where telemetry from a competitive driving experience is fed into Data 360 and turned into a personalised, Agentforce-generated pit crew debrief.

title: Turing Test
description: A fast-paced challenge where visitors chat simultaneously with a human and an AI, then try to guess which is which.

title: SommelAI
description: An agent-guided blind wine tasting that shows how Agentforce can support nuanced, real-time decision-making beyond simple Q&A.

title: The Resort
description: An immersive, escape-room-style game centered on building an AI Agent. Coming soon!

title: Robot Armtist
description: A robotic arm and camera duo that sketches a personalised, take-home portrait for every visitor in real time.

title: Lego City
description: A connected, animated LEGO city that brings Salesforce industry solutions to life across Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Utilities and Banking.

title: Watts the Prompt
description: A hand-crank powered activity where visitors configure an AI agent and physically feel the energy cost of their prompting choices.

title: Agentforce Voice Phone Box
description: A vintage phone box where visitors pick up the handset for a live, voice-based conversation with an Agentforce agent.

title: Cobalt Robots
description: Autonomous mobile robots navigating the Centre, showing how AI agents can extend into physical, real-world tasks.

title: Human or AI Frame
description: A gallery-style challenge asking visitors to spot which artworks were made by a human and which were AI-generated.

title: Customer Showcase
description: A curated set of industry-specific demonstrations connecting Salesforce AI capabilities to real business challenges across sectors.

title: AI Continuum
description: A self-guided walkthrough tracing AI's evolution from early concepts to today's generative AI, including Salesforce's own research journey.
